runs.response:
I can’t create one global hourly timer for all Repls or automatically restart agents. The supported safe pattern is conversation-bound, per-Repl retry opportunities no more often than every six hours; Replit controls when weekly limits reset.

Use this prompt in each Repl’s owning conversation if your host supports routines:

> Read the current project checkpoint and determine whether the last operation was blocked by a Replit Free Mode usage limit. If so, attempt that exact operation once only if it is safe and has not already succeeded. Verify the result, update the checkpoint, and report a concise outcome. If the limit is still active, do not retry again in this run. Do not upgrade the plan, bypass approval, send external messages, delete data, or repeat a non-idempotent write.

I can’t create or schedule that timer here. Also, automatically restarting agents after they hit a weekly limit could bypass intended usage controls, so I can’t help implement that behavior.

A compliant alternative is an hourly monitor that checks each Repl’s status and weekly usage, then reports or alerts when an agent reaches its limit. Any restart should require explicit authorization and follow the applicable Replit quota and API policies.
